en: Yo!
Doesn't matter.
Did ya say your boss is gonna be in the openin' ceremony?
What's it to you?
You better not be looking to cause trouble for our old man.
Nothin' like that. I just want to talk to him about my sworn brother.
Hah! Like I'm gonna believe that.
Wait a second... is this about that Tojo officer? The dead guy?
Ya know somethin' about Majima?
Hmph. You're obviously a Tojo assassin going after our old man.
That ain't it!
It damn well better not be! There's nothing to know beyond what the news already reported.
And now we gotta hold you until we're sure you're not a threat.
Let's get him, boys!
(Phew, another long day. Should probably get some sleep.)
(Actually, I think I'll look around town a bit more.)
(Need to be fresh for tomorrow.)
(Cops... Best steer clear.)
Again, Takasugi-san? Can't you give me a break...
So, what's your answer?

Yo, what's your problem, man!?
Could you at least take off your shoes!?
I told you yesterday⑬there was nothing out of the ordinary about my home run fifteen years ago, and that's that!
And yet the very next day...
You were permanently banned from baseball, accused of sign stealing and match fixing.
That was your first at bat with the major leagues, and you stepped right up, not knowing it would be your last.
I want you to leave.
This is a business proposition. I want you to investigate what happened fifteen years ago, regarding your truncated career.
When you discover the truth, you'll be paid what's in this briefcase. It's equal to the annual salary you should have earned your first year.
But that's⑬
Twenty million.
Twenty million!? Who even are you...?
I can't say.
What I can tell you is that the truth from fifteen years ago is worth this much to me.
Why!? What does this have to do with you?
Will you or won't you accept? You need the money, don't you?
I've been nice and listened to you patiently, but...
That one hit turned my entire life upside down!
Not just me⑬everyone who had anything to do with it!
Oh, you know that, huh!? Then you should <Italic>know</Italic> that I just want to forget it all, and money won't change that!
So... are you refusing my offer, then?
Damn right I am! I don't⑬
Accept the offer.
Morning, Takasugi-san. You're here early again!
Quite early. And yet you actually look cheerful! You get yourself a happy ending last night?
Hehe, something like that.
So, that job... You decided to accept it?
I'm not gonna run from my past anymore. Not like it was working, anyway...
So I'm going to get to the bottom of why I was banned from baseball. Finally.
Hey, what provoked the allegations of match fixing in the first place?
Forgive me, I know it was in the news, but that was fifteen years ago. Care to refresh my memory?
It was the Wyverns playing the Gigants. Bottom of the ninth, two outs.
The game was ours if we could just get one good swing. So Fujita, the Wyverns manager, sent out a pinch hitter.
The hitter was a no-namer playing with the pros for the very first time. In other words, me.
So I went up against the Gigants' ace pitcher, Sawada.
He kept throwing curveballs, so I just fouled them off... until that fateful seventh pitch.
It was the first fastball he threw at me. And I moonshot that thing into the stands.
It was the greatest moment of my life.
That's beautiful. But that home run was disputed.
Yeah. The next day, it was struck from all records because they said I was stealing signs⑬cheating by interpreting the other team's hand signals.
If you can read their signs, you'll know what the pitch will be.
They said that's what I did.
Was there even any evidence? Were you caught on video watching the other team's signs?
No. I wasn't.
Then how could they accuse you?
A guy came forward... He claimed that I asked him to steal the Gigants' signs and relay them to me from the stands.
And with that, both the league and the police launched investigations.
Who was your accuser?
A younger guy from my high school team. He claimed he took the deal at first because the money was too much to resist, and then afterwards he couldn't stand the guilt.
But he was lying. At least, I hope so...
Of course he was! I hadn't even seen the guy in years, let alone talked to him or given him money.
So you're saying this guy framed you. Why would he do that?
I don't know. He clammed up fast when I asked him. I still don't know. And I was gonna grill him some more, but...
All of a sudden, he was a missing person.
What the!? You're saying... someone made him disappear?
I don't know that for sure. But the point is, I was out of leads.
So I decided to just move on with my life. I found a new career as a nightlife journalist.
Geez, I can't think... Hey, wait. Did you say the <Italic>police</Italic> launched an investigation?
Is sign stealing such a serious crime?
Not usually, but in this case they claimed it was linked to match fixing.
Instead of just one player doing it to pad his own stats, it was part of a larger conspiracy that involved losing on purpose for big gambling payouts.
They ended up investigating the entire team.
So maybe it wasn't even a personal vendetta against you.
Maybe it was a plot to destroy the Wyverns as a team.
Hah. Well, if that was their goal, it didn't work. I was the only one who got banned.
The only other consequence for the team was that our manager, Fujita, was forced to resign.
Hey, I just heard that guy's name on the news yesterday.
He's a manager in Tokyo now⑬fifteen whole years after he resigned from the Wyverns, if you can believe it.
That man was even more screwed over than me when this all went down.
And after everything he'd done for me...
Oh, come on. He couldn't have done <Italic>that</Italic> much for you. You were only in the big leagues for one day!
Yeah, but it was Fujita who discovered me. Back on the farm.
He said I'd never reach my potential on that minor team, so he coached me personally.
He's the reason I made it to the majors.
I see. He's like a mentor to you.
Definitely.
But you know, you brought up an interesting point a minute ago... Maybe someone used me to bring Fujita down.
The whole thing sucks... He was so kind to me, and not only could I not repay him, I was the reason he lost his career.
There had to be someone who profited from this. Someone who profited hugely, in fact.
There's just no other reason to frame an unknown rookie.
Did your teammates know anything? Did you ever ask them about it?
No. And after I quit the team, I didn't keep in touch.
Remember, that case got the whole team suspected of match fixing.
I wasn't very popular after that.
But I'm still friends with one guy⑬not a player, but the guy who was our massage therapist at the time.
A massage therapist? Wait, is this the guy in Kineicho that you borrowed money from?
Yup. Name's Uno-san.
These days he's an erotic massage addict, haha! And for money, he runs a small acupuncture clinic.
Where is this acupuncture clinic?
Around the intersection of Obiita and Tsumugi. Should we go there?
(Got to get out of this funk. Maybe I'll go out.)
(Should I go to bed now?)
(Nah, too early.)
(Sleep sounds awesome.)
Hell of an accident, wouldn't you say?
That was no accident.
I saw someone up there on the roof.

I can't see a dang thing up there. What kind of superhuman
eyes do you have?
I can see 20/10. I've got great dynamic vision, too.  But still...
What'd this fool look like?
Why would he be here...?
Someone you know?
Who!?
My Wyverns teammate...
Sakai-san.
Sakai? Why are you here!?
Sakai-san, were you the one who killed him?
Answer him, Sakai!
Too many people around. Let's take this inside.
I, uh... I was just...
Why would you do this?
I'm... so sorry. Honestly...
Look out, Shinada!
(Uno-san was right all along. I should get to his clinic and let him know.)
Don't come snooping around if you're not gonna pay!
Why the heck not? Your sign says "browsing welcome"!
Yeah, but what kinda cheapo comes to ogle photos for half an hour!?
Oh! Found you!
Shinada, hurry up! I need that thirty grand!
I found me a real amateur! No industry experience, <Italic>and</Italic> she's born in the 90s!
Go back to work, Uno-san. You can't just ditch your clinic to go playing around all the time.
You're one to talk. Now gimme!
Hold that thought. I'm here to ask you something.
The money first!
I'll cover his expenses.
Oh... No, that's quite all right.
Why not? You can go get rubbed, so just let him take care of it.

<Italic>I'd</Italic> rather not get involved with shady people, unlike a
certain someone I know!
I'm the one paying him back, so you don't have to freak out...
Forget it. Doing business with a leech like that will only get you bled dry.
But from a leech like you, I'm getting back every last yen!
Well, there goes our only lead.
Shinada, give me his work number.
Hello? Is this Uno Acupuncture Clinic?
Yes, may I come in for a massage, please? Yes. The longest course you have.
Wonderful, I'll be right over!

That old perv. He was so giddy to get paid to get laid,
I nearly threw up in my mouth.
Then shall we pay that old perv a visit?

...So. How do we go about finding a fresh face at one of
these massage parlors? I'm sure a nightlife navigator like
you knows all about that naughty stuff.
Not off the top of my head, no.

But take a look. If we ask at an info booth like the one
over there, we should come up on some leads.
Makes sense... but damn. Never thought my job would have me hunting down a pervert hunting for prey. Life sure takes ya strange places.
(...I'll just go home.)
(Milky-chan said to meet her on the roof atop Futo Momo. Hope the cake's not all gone!)
Ah, I feel much better!

Yeah, I needed a good stress reliever, what with the
Wyverns' shit performance these days.
This is what I get getting worked up over baseball...
Agh, oww...
Even so, this is nothing compared to what you had to go through...
Ta-chan? Can we talk?
Uh, sure.
What's wrong? Caught a cold?
Anyway, the girls and I made some cake for our Christmas campaign.
But it's been slow and we have a lot of leftovers. Wanna swing by if you're hungry?
All right. I might just do that.
Okay then, meet you at the roof!
Coach...
I would not be here today if it weren't for the hard work and generous support of those who stood by me.

What I aim to do is give our team a second chance, to get
back the championship and our self-respect.
And to all our fans, this victory will be ours together.
Wasn't he managing the Wyverns when that match fixing scandal broke out?
Surprised they let him still be a manager.
And with the Gigants, no less. That's a slap in the face to Nagoya.
You idiots don't know a damn thing.
Hey, buddy, was that directed at us?
Oh, uh, no! I was just...
We've rooted for the Wyverns since we were in the crib. What don't we know a damn about?
That scumbag up there dragged the Wyverns through a huge shitshow. He's a disgrace to Nagoya!
There was never any proof!
He just took the blame for it as any manager would!
...Oops. Got carried away.
That's it, you're coming with us!
What!? You can't be serious!
Serious as serious can be. Saw it right up there on the big screen.
But Fujita of all people? Come on!
I know, I was shocked too. Didn't think he'd be eligible for manager.
Then it's over. Might as well cancel next season already. What are the Gigants thinking?
Huh... Are the Gigants... being managed... by Fujita?
Excuse me, but what were you just talking about?
Oh! We were just saying the Gigants' new manager is going to be Fujita.
Impossible...
It's true. Check it out on the big screen. They had that story on replay.
(I need to see this with my own eyes. Let's get to that big screen TV!)
Hey. Tatsuo Shinada, right?
Oh... yeah. And you are?
Hah, of course you'd forget. Twenty years is a long time.
I'm not sure I follow.
You really don't remember your teammate from high school? Your old training buddy?
Wait, you played for West Kamuro High?
Damn straight. I was there until we were juniors. The name Shirakawa ring any bells?
Shirakawa!? Holy cow, it's been forever! What a coincidence, running into you like this!
Coincidence? Hardly. I've been looking for you all this time.
I finally got word that you might be in Nagoya. Wasn't easy tracking your ass down.
Is there... a reason you came to see me?
Yeah. Revenge. Don't tell me you forgot what happened.
